role: Verifies that build output matches the manifest recorded at build time, confirming both file integrity and commit provenance before a build can be trusted for deployment.
behaviorDescription: Hashes every file in a build output directory and compares against a manifest recorded immediately after compilation by the trusted build pipeline. The manifest carries the commit SHA and build timestamp alongside file hashes, so a mismatch signals either tampering after build or a stale/incorrect manifest. Detection only for verifyBuildIntegrity; recordBuildManifest writes a new manifest and must only be invoked by the build pipeline itself.
hardStops: verifyBuildIntegrity never modifies any file — comparison and reporting only
recordBuildManifest must only be invoked by the trusted build pipeline immediately after compilation — never manually, never on a schedule
A block-severity finding must halt deployment; this bot's HITL classification is Synchronous Gate, not Alert, because a failed build integrity check should stop the pipeline, not just notify someone
